questions.q: Which African country was never colonised, apart from a brief Italian occupation?
questions.why: It defeated Italy at Adwa in 1896.

questions.q: Which 1896 battle saw Ethiopia defeat an Italian army?
questions.why: Adwa Victory Day is 2 March.

questions.q: Which last emperor of Ethiopia was crowned in 1930?
questions.why: He was overthrown in 1974.

questions.q: Which ancient kingdom built tall stone obelisks at its capital?
questions.why: Its capital was Aksum.

questions.q: Which 3.2-million-year-old fossil skeleton was found in Ethiopia in 1974?
questions.why: In Amharic she is called Dinkinesh.

questions.q: Which queen of legend visited King Solomon?
questions.why: Ethiopians call her Makeda.

questions.q: Which emperor won the Battle of Adwa and founded Addis Ababa?
questions.why: He ruled from 1889 to 1913.

questions.q: Which emperor built the castles of Gondar?
questions.why: Gondar became the capital in 1636.

questions.q: Which Aksumite king made Christianity the state religion in the 300s?
questions.why: Ethiopia is one of the oldest Christian nations.

questions.q: Which military regime ruled Ethiopia from 1974 to 1991?
questions.why: Mengistu Haile Mariam led it.

questions.q: Which country gained independence from Ethiopia in 1993?
questions.why: It followed a 30-year war.

questions.q: Which emperor took his own life at Magdala rather than surrender to the British in 1868?
questions.why: He tried to modernise the country.

questions.q: Which drink is said to have been discovered in Ethiopia?
questions.why: Legend says a goatherd named Kaldi found it.

questions.q: Which 4.4-million-year-old skeleton from the Afar region is nicknamed 'Ardi'?
questions.why: It is older than Lucy.

questions.q: What is the capital of Ethiopia?
questions.why: It hosts the African Union headquarters.

questions.q: Which lake is the source of the Blue Nile?
questions.why: It has island monasteries.

questions.q: Which mountains include Ethiopia's highest peak, Ras Dashen?
questions.why: Gelada monkeys live there.

questions.q: Which runner won the 1960 Olympic marathon barefoot?
questions.why: He won again in 1964 wearing shoes.

questions.q: Which runner won Olympic 10,000 m gold in 1996 and 2000?
questions.why: He set many world records.

questions.q: Which Ethiopian Prime Minister won the 2019 Nobel Peace Prize?
questions.why: It was for making peace with Eritrea.

questions.q: Which king had churches carved from solid rock in the 1100s–1200s?
questions.why: The town is named after him.

questions.q: What is the spongy flatbread made from teff called?
questions.why: Stews are served on top of it.

questions.q: How many months are in the Ethiopian calendar?
questions.why: The calendar is about seven to eight years behind the Gregorian one.

questions.q: What is Ethiopia's currency?
questions.why: The National Bank of Ethiopia issues it.

questions.q: What is Ethiopia's main working language?
questions.why: Afaan Oromo has the most native speakers.

questions.q: Which spicy chicken stew is a national dish?
questions.why: It is cooked with berbere spice.

questions.q: Which depression in the northeast is one of the hottest places on Earth?
questions.why: It has colourful sulphur springs.

questions.q: Which September festival celebrates the finding of the True Cross with a bonfire?
questions.why: It is on UNESCO's heritage list.

questions.q: Which dam on the Blue Nile is Africa's largest hydropower project?
questions.why: It stands near the border with Sudan.

questions.q: Which January festival celebrates Epiphany with processions?
questions.why: Replicas of the Ark of the Covenant are carried.
